before_github_actions.interpretation: The donor-specific boundary tests exposed unsupported inputs that the preimplementation parser did not reject, while the governed terminal state remained intact.

demonstrated_improvements.capability: reject unsafe/path-traversal or absolute WFDB data-file references
demonstrated_improvements.before: no data-file path/basename validation in parseHeaderDetailed/parseSignalLine

demonstrated_improvements.capability: reject multi-file signal references in the narrow single-buffer decoder
demonstrated_improvements.before: signal dataFile fields were parsed but not coherency-checked

demonstrated_improvements.capability: bind header record identity to its expected .dat basename
demonstrated_improvements.before: record and data-file identity were not coupled
lead names were not uniqueness-checked by the native parser

demonstrated_improvements.capability: reject multi-segment/hostile record identifiers and hostile lead tokens
demonstrated_improvements.before: record and lead token shapes were not bounded

demonstrated_improvements.capability: strictly reject unsupported WFDB format modifiers
demonstrated_improvements.before: numeric coercion could accept alternate textual forms that evaluated to 16
demonstrated_improvements.after: only exact format token 16 is accepted

demonstrated_improvements.before: no donor-specific corpus for these WFDB field/cohesion invariants
demonstrated_improvements.after: 17 synthetic donor-boundary cases are included in npm test

non_improvements_and_limits: No new WFDB encoding was added.
No remote or cloud source resolution was enabled.
No diagnostic performance claim is made.
External-source PTB-XL gate was not substituted by synthetic CI.
